buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 2. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 3. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 4. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 5. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 6. Rate Contract Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they dont upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the

Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Scope of Work The contractor shall carry out all wooden work as per the approved drawings, designs, measurements, spe cifications, and instructions already mentioned 1. Quality of Materials Only good-quality, approved plywood, laminates, MDF, particle boards, solid wood, hardware, and accesso ries shall be used. Materials must be new and free from defects, termite damage, moisture, cracks, and warping. All material should be approved prior to use. Any substandard material shall be replaced at the contractor's own cost. 1. Workmanship All work must be completed with proper finishing, accurate measurements, and professional workmanship. Edges, corners, joints, hinges, handles, locks, and fittings must be properly finished. All doors, drawers, shutters, cabinets, and furniture must function smoothly. No sharp edges, protruding nails, screws, or unsafe fittings shall be permitted. 1. Hospital Safety and Hygiene The contractor must ensure minimum disturbance to hospital operations, patients, doctors, and staff. Work in patient-care areas must be carried out only with prior permission. Dust, noise, and debris must be controlled. Work areas must be properly covered and cleaned daily. No material, tools, or waste shall obstruct corridors, emergency exits, fire exits, or patient movement. Strong-smelling adhesives, paints, polishes, and chemicals shall not be used in occupied patient-care area s without prior approval. All electrical and fire-safety requirements must be followed. 1. Labour and Supervision The contractor shall provide skilled and experienced carpenters and supervisors. All workers must follow hospital security and safety protocols. Workers shall not enter restricted areas without permission. The contractor shall be responsible for the conduct and safety of its workers.

1. Time Schedule The work must be completed within the agreed timeline mentioned in the work order. Any delay must be communicated in advance with valid reasons. Delay without an acceptable reason may attract penalties as specified in the work order. 1. Inspection and Approval its authorized representative shall have the right to inspect materials and workmanship at any stage. Any defective, damaged, or improperly executed work shall be rectified by the contractor without addition al charges. Final payment shall be released only after satisfactory completion and approval of the work. 1. Payment Terms Payment shall be made as per the approved quotation and mutually agreed payment schedule. No additional work or extra charges shall be accepted without prior written approval. The contractor must submit an invoice along with the completion report. Applicable taxes and statutory deductions shall be dealt with as per prevailing laws. 1. Damage and Liability The contractor shall be responsible for any damage caused to hospital property, equipment, walls, flooring , electrical installations, or other infrastructure during execution. Any such damage must be repaired or compensated for by the contractor at their own expense. The contractor shall be responsible for the safety and statutory compliance of its workers. 1. Electrical and Fire Safety Wooden panels and furniture must not obstruct fire extinguishers, sprinklers, smoke detectors, fire alarms, or electrical panels. No unauthorized electrical modifications shall be carried out. Materials and installation methods must comply with applicable fire-safety requirements. 1. Warranty and Defect Liability The contractor shall provide a minimum warranty of 10yr from the date of final handover against manufac turing defects, poor workmanship, loose fittings, and installation-related defects. Any defects identified during the warranty period shall be rectified free of cost within a reasonable period. 1. Cleanliness and Handover The contractor shall remove all unused materials, sawdust, packing materials, and debris after completion . The work area must be handed over in a clean and usable condition.

All keys, hardware details, and relevant handover documents shall be submitted to authority 1. Termination of Work Authority reserves the right to stop or terminate the work if: The contractor fails to maintain quality standards. There is repeated delay in completion. Safety and hospital protocols are violated. Unauthorized or substandard materials are used. The contractor fails to comply with agreed terms and conditions. 14. Acceptance of Terms The contractor confirms that they have read, understood, and agreed to all the above terms and condition s and shall comply with them throughout the execution of the work. .
